given_when_then.given: The Real-Time Inventory Snapshot shows an item with 2 days remaining until its sell-by date, and the configured threshold is 3 days.
given_when_then.when: The system performs its scheduled inventory quality check.
given_when_then.then: The system flags the item in the Product Catalog and sends an alert to the Store Partner.

given_when_then.given: A customer attempts to place an Order Request containing an item flagged as 'nearing expiry'.
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine processes the request.
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the Order Request and notifies the customer that the item is unavailable due to quality constraints.

given_when_then.given: An item in the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot has a remaining shelf life less than the configured safety margin.
given_when_then.when: The system detects the item status.
given_when_then.then: The system updates the Product Catalog status immediately to indicate the item is nearing expiry.

success_criteria: The item is flagged in the Product Catalog when the remaining shelf life is less than the configured safety margin.
The alert is logged with a timestamp and the specific item identifier.
The Order Request is rejected if the primary fulfillment source contains items flagged as 'nearing expiry'.
The Product Catalog status is updated immediately upon detecting an expiry alert.
The Store Partner receives an alert when the system flags an item as nearing expiry.
